title: End and retire
summary: yoke sessions terminate SESSION-ID --reason R permanently ends a session from any live steering seat, releasing its claims, cancelling its queued messages and asking its relay to stop the process. It refuses an operator-driven desktop chat (codex-desktop, claude-desktop, cursor-desktop) as TERMINATION_OPERATOR_SURFACE and writes nothing: Yoke never launched that chat and cannot stop it. The refusal lists the chat's active claim ids; a steering-seat holder frees each with yoke claims work release --claim-id N --reason R, which leaves the session intact, and its operator closes the chat.
